name: What accessibility modifications can be added during a tub installation?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility modifications can be added during a tub installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessible modifications include installing a walk-in tub with a low entry door, setting up integrated grab bars securely anchored into wall framing, and applying slip-resistant floor textures. Homeowners can also opt for tubs with built-in contoured seating, handheld shower wands with reachable controls, and wider clearance around the apron for easier transfers. Planning these features early allows the contractor to install solid wood backing inside the wall studs before closing up drywall or setting tile, ensuring that safety hardware remains rigid and stable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include walk-in tubs with doors, reinforced grab bars anchored to studs, low-threshold aprons, slip-resistant floors, and handheld shower wands.
